title.zh: 浮点数的三段位：符号、指数、尾数
title.en: The three fields of a float: sign, exponent, significand

description.zh: 浮点数是二进制的科学计数法：1 位符号，8 位带偏移的指数，23 位尾数加一个不存的隐藏位。输入任何数，看它被存成哪些位、差了多少。
description.en: A float is binary scientific notation: one sign bit, a biased 8-bit exponent and a 23-bit significand with a hidden leading 1. Type any number and see its bits and its error.

zh: 符号位 指数位 尾数位

title.zh: ulp：浮点数的格子越往外越稀
title.en: ulp: floats get sparser as they grow

description.zh: 每过一个 2 的幂，相邻两个浮点数的间隔就宽一倍：绝对误差随大小增长，相对误差大致不变。float 能连续数到 16,777,216。
description.en: Past every power of two the gap between neighbouring floats doubles: absolute error grows with size while relative error stays roughly fixed. A float counts integers only up to 16,777,216.

zh: float 能精确表示的最大整数

title.zh: 舍入模式：落在两格之间怎么选
title.en: Rounding modes: choosing between two neighbours

description.zh: 就近取偶、向零、向正负无穷和随机舍入，五条线比较同一个数加很多次的结果；低精度累加为什么会停滞。
description.en: Round to nearest even, toward zero, toward ±infinity and stochastic rounding, compared by adding the same number many times; why low-precision sums stall.

zh: 保护位 舍入位 粘滞位

title.zh: 次正规数、无穷大和 NaN

description.zh: 指数全 0 是零和次正规数，让数一点点下溢到零；全 1 是无穷大和 NaN。拖一个数往零走，看它丢掉有效位，以及冲零模式怎么做。
description.en: An all-zero exponent holds zero and subnormals, so numbers underflow gradually; all ones holds infinity and NaN. Walk a number toward zero and watch it lose bits, with and without flush-to-zero.

title.zh: 灾难性抵消与求和算法

description.zh: 两个相近的数相减，前面的位抵消，误差被推到最前面：一遍法算方差会得出负数。顺序求和、两两求和与 Kahan 补偿求和的误差比较。
description.en: Subtracting two close numbers cancels the leading digits and promotes the error: a one-pass variance can come out negative. Naive, pairwise and Kahan compensated summation compared.

title.en: FMA: multiply and add with one rounding

description.zh: a × b + c 先算准确的积再加，只在最后舍入一次。它让 x*x − y*y 在 x = y 时可能得出负数，对点积的精度帮助却不大。
description.en: a × b + c computed with the exact product and one final rounding. It can make x*x − y*y negative when x = y, yet barely changes the accuracy of a dot product.

title.zh: FP16、BF16 和 8 位浮点：为 AI 砍掉的位
title.en: FP16, BF16 and 8-bit floats: bits cut for AI

description.zh: 同样 16 位，FP16 多给尾数，BF16 保住 binary32 的范围。把一组数放进各种格式，看多少下溢、多少溢出；各格式的范围和精度表。
description.en: With the same 16 bits, FP16 favours precision and BF16 keeps the range of binary32. Put a spread of values into each format and see how many underflow or overflow; a table of ranges and precisions.

title.en: INT8 and block scaling: MX and NVFP4

description.zh: 低位数的数配一个共同的比例。整个张量一个比例，离群值会把其余的数压没；OCP MX 每 32 个数一个 8 位比例。七种量化方式的信噪比比较。
description.en: Few-bit values share a common scale. With one scale per tensor an outlier crushes everything else; OCP MX gives every 32 values an 8-bit scale. Seven quantisation schemes compared by signal-to-noise ratio.

title.zh: SIMD：一条指令算一排，以及掩码
title.en: SIMD: one instruction, many lanes, and masks

description.zh: 宽寄存器切成很多条车道，一条指令每条车道做同一件事；判断变成掩码。从 SSE 到 AVX-512，看车道数、掩码和循环尾部。
description.en: A wide register split into lanes, one instruction doing the same thing in every lane; branches become masks. From SSE to AVX-512: lanes, mask bits and the loop tail.

title.zh: 自动向量化与求和顺序

description.zh: 编译器只在能证明结果不变时才向量化；浮点加法不满足结合律，所以求和默认不向量化。对齐、步长、gather，以及多车道求和为什么结果会变。
description.en: A compiler vectorises only what it can prove unchanged; float addition is not associative, so sums are not vectorised by default. Alignment, strides, gather, and why a multi-lane sum changes the result.

zh: 结构体数组 数组结构体
en: array of structs vs struct of arrays

title.zh: 乘加的延迟、吞吐和宽向量降频
title.en: FMA latency, throughput and wide-vector clocks

description.zh: 延迟 4 拍、每拍两条，要 8 个累加器才喂得满；峰值算力怎么算。AVX-512 的频率许可让一小段向量代码拖慢后面将近一毫秒。
description.en: Four cycles of latency and two per cycle need eight accumulators; how peak FLOPS is computed. AVX-512 frequency licences let a short vector burst slow the next millisecond of code.

title.zh: SVE、SME 和 AMX：不定宽的向量与矩阵单元
title.en: SVE, SME and AMX: length-agnostic vectors and matrix units

description.zh: 同一份 SVE 程序在 128 到 2048 位的硬件上都能跑；矩阵单元用外积一次做 n² 次乘加。苹果 M4 的 SME 和英特尔 AMX。
description.en: One SVE binary runs on hardware from 128 to 2048 bits; matrix units do n² multiply-adds per outer product. SME on Apple M4 and Intel AMX.

title.zh: CPU 数值计算的前沿（2026 年 11 月）

description.zh: 已经确立的标准、已经做出来的芯片、厂商的规范和说法：AVX10.2 的 FP8 与随机舍入、Arm SME2、IEEE P3109 草案。
description.en: Established standards, shipped chips, and vendor specifications and claims: FP8 and stochastic rounding in AVX10.2, Arm SME2, the IEEE P3109 draft.

reason.zh: 第 2 章从第 1 章的 23 位尾数推出相邻两个浮点数的间隔：每过一个 2 的幂就宽一倍。
reason.en: Chapter 2 derives the gap between neighbouring floats from chapter 1’s 23-bit significand: it doubles past every power of two.

reason.zh: 第 3 章回答第 2 章留下的问题：一个结果落在两格之间时取哪一格。
reason.en: Chapter 3 answers what chapter 2 leaves open: which grid point a result takes when it falls between two.

label.en: The two ends of the exponent field

reason.zh: 第 4 章讲第 1 章指数字段全 0 和全 1 两种留作特殊用途的编码。
reason.en: Chapter 4 covers the all-zeros and all-ones exponent codes that chapter 1 sets aside.

reason.zh: 第 5 章看第 3 章的每次舍入在相减和长串求和里怎么被放大，以及怎么补回来。
reason.en: Chapter 5 shows how chapter 3’s per-operation rounding is amplified by subtraction and long sums, and how to compensate.

reason.zh: 第 6 章的 FMA 把乘和加之间那一次第 3 章的舍入省掉。
reason.en: Chapter 6’s FMA removes one of chapter 3’s roundings, the one between the multiply and the add.

label.en: The same three fields, fewer bits

reason.zh: 第 7 章把第 1 章的符号、指数、尾数三段压到 16 位和 8 位。
reason.en: Chapter 7 squeezes chapter 1’s sign, exponent and significand into 16 and 8 bits.

label.en: Narrow elements plus a shared scale

reason.zh: 第 8 章给第 7 章的窄格式每 32 个数配一个共享的缩放因子。
reason.en: Chapter 8 gives chapter 7’s narrow formats one shared scale per block of 32.

reason.zh: 第 10 章看编译器什么时候能把普通循环变成第 9 章的向量指令。
reason.en: Chapter 10 looks at when a compiler can turn an ordinary loop into chapter 9’s vector instructions.

reason.zh: 第 10 章说明向量化求和改了加法顺序，结果和第 5 章一样会变。
reason.en: Chapter 10 explains that a vectorised sum reorders the additions, so the result changes as in chapter 5.

reason.zh: 第 11 章用第 6 章的 FMA 指令测延迟和吞吐：一个累加器只用得上八分之一。
reason.en: Chapter 11 times chapter 6’s FMA: with one accumulator a core uses an eighth of its throughput.

reason.zh: 第 11 章看第 9 章的 512 位向量在吞吐和频率上各付出什么。
reason.en: Chapter 11 weighs what chapter 9’s 512-bit vectors cost in throughput and in clock frequency.

label.en: Vectors of any width, and matrices

reason.zh: 第 12 章把第 9 章的定宽向量推广成不定宽的谓词向量和矩阵单元。
reason.en: Chapter 12 generalises chapter 9’s fixed-width vectors into length-agnostic predicated vectors and matrix units.

reason.zh: 第 1 章接着《一堆开关是怎么学会算数的》第 10 章，逐位看 0.1 被存成什么。
reason.en: Chapter 1 picks up from chapter 10 of How a Pile of Switches Learned to Count and shows bit by bit what 0.1 is stored as.

reason.zh: 第 4 章拿第 5 章的整数溢出对照：浮点数不绕回，变成无穷大。
reason.en: Chapter 4 contrasts the integer overflow of the switches essay’s chapter 5: a float does not wrap, it becomes infinity.

reason.zh: 第 7 章的 8 位和 4 位格式在 GPU 张量核心上能跑多快，见《GPU 是怎么算的》第 8 章。
reason.en: How fast chapter 7’s 8-bit and 4-bit formats run on GPU tensor cores is in chapter 8 of How a GPU Computes.

reason.zh: 第 8 章的格式让推理少读一半字节；为什么这就快将近一倍，见《为什么计算一直在等内存》第 8 章。
reason.en: Chapter 8’s formats halve the bytes read in inference; why that nearly doubles the speed is chapter 8 of the memory essay.

reason.zh: 第 9 章的掩码让车道两边都算，省掉分支预测猜错的代价。
reason.en: Chapter 9’s masks compute both sides in every lane, avoiding the cost of a mispredicted branch.

reason.zh: 第 10 章算没对齐的向量读有多少跨两条缓存行，缓存行见《CPU 的三级缓存是怎么工作的》第 2 章。
reason.en: Chapter 10 counts how many unaligned vector loads split two cache lines; cache lines are chapter 2 of the cache essay.

label.en: Wide vectors draw power, so the clock drops

reason.zh: 第 11 章的频率许可来自《电是怎么送进 CPU 的》第 2 章的功率与电压、频率的关系。
reason.en: Chapter 11’s frequency licences follow from the power–voltage–frequency relation in chapter 2 of the power essay.

reason.zh: 第 11 章的模型假设数据在 L1；从内存来时就成了屋顶线问题。
reason.en: Chapter 11’s model assumes the data is in L1; when it comes from memory it becomes a roofline question.

reason.zh: 第 12 章的 CPU 矩阵单元和 GPU 张量核心是同一个思路：每个数搬进来一次就地用 n 次。
reason.en: Chapter 12’s CPU matrix units follow the same idea as GPU tensor cores: each number is brought in once and used n times.
